clipReactionAssembly.model: Midpoint rectangular tributaries and simply-supported half-span loads; signed vector assembly, not a compatible film/collector solution.
clipReactionAssembly.frame: Right cap X is global +x; R is local cylindrical outward radial. At joint phi, outward normal n=(sin(phi),cos(phi)), increasing-phi tangent t=(cos(phi),-sin(phi)). Negative normal demand is inward. Azimuthal component is zero in this symmetric strip approximation.
clipReactionAssembly.otherCap: Reflect global X force and the X components of n/t; R and local normal/tangent components are unchanged. Rotate the R basis for each of the 666 meridians.
clipReactionAssembly.tributary: Each span uses L=40*dphi and w=2*40*sin(pi/666)*cos(phi_mid), with uniform inward normal at phi_mid. Full pressure pitch crosses the 4mm stock gaps; the gap removes no pressure area. Bar radial offset is not used to shrink the loaded surface.
clipReactionAssembly.status: Known cap-bar demand only. Shoulder/barrel and polar collectors, film in-plane tension, bond peel, actual restraint and load sharing remain UNKNOWN. No fictitious neighbouring bar or zero interface load is asserted. Two bonds/angles/bolts share the known resultant equally for the inherited nominal screen; the full resultant acts at the existing10mm angle lever. This does not qualify the failed fit or transfer.
